# Cripple Creek Backcountry

> > Colorado and Seattle's premier backcountry ski touring, splitboarding, and mountain biking retailer with expert services and guided education.

Cripple Creek Backcountry operates specialty retail locations across Colorado (Carbondale, Denver, Avon, Aspen Highlands, Silverthorne) and Seattle, offering backcountry gear from brands like Dynafit, Salomon, Black Diamond, and The North Face. Founded in 2012, they provide rentals, custom boot fitting, guided tours through Aspen Expeditions, and avalanche education alongside their retail operations.

- [Cripple Creek Avon](https://cripplecreekbc.com/pages/cripple-creek-avon): Avon location partnered with High Gear Cyclery for bike/ski services
- [Cripple Creek Aspen Highlands](https://cripplecreekbc.com/pages/cripple-creek-aspen-highlands): Aspen Highlands base location for ski touring and avalanche education
